root_turn.title: Public repository governance and integrity controls

objective: Implement and prove trusted repository integrity, handoff, exact-head ChatGPT review, existing-gh-CLI operation, exact-head owner authorization records, separate merge-only execution, model-role, and anti-slop controls without adding biblical domain behavior.
activated_user_visible_capability: None; owner and reviewer governance only.
activated_invariants: Sol is the exclusive implementation author; Luna cannot write code or executable configuration.
Codex may use the existing authenticated gh CLI session as @abbudjoe.
No GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN/GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN override is active; stored gh authentication is used.
Token display, authentication mutation, repository administration, and unactivated write API operations are prohibited.
The implementation root turn stops before authorization and merge.
Only Joseph can provide the binding exact-head owner approval in the current ChatGPT conversation.
A separate merge-only Sol turn may squash-merge only the exact approved head after every required check passes.
The governance report must disclose that GitHub cannot distinguish Joseph from Codex under the shared credential.
No unactivated contract or future scaffold is implemented.
activated_data_stores: Git repository and GitHub PR/check metadata only
required_tests: Valid and invalid handoff fixtures, including parent mismatch and non-handoff final commit.
Ruleset verification against the live public repository.
Stored gh authentication preflight with abbudjoe active and no token override variables.
Exact-head and stale-head ChatGPT review and owner-authorization fixtures.
Negative direct-push, missing-authorization merge, stale-record, unresolved-conversation, force-push, and deletion probes.
required_evidence: One complete draft-PR handoff and exact-head review cycle.
Nonsecret gh authentication receipt showing active login abbudjoe and no token override variables.
OwnerMergeAuthorizationRecord for the W00 proof PR.
Separate merge-only prompt and squash-merge receipt.
explicit_non_goals: No biblical domain model or VS-01 runtime.
No LangGraph, Inspect, inference, embedding, vector, Lambda, training, or web UI work.
No new fine-grained token, GitHub App, or separate Codex GitHub account.
prohibited_scaffolding: No future service or package shells.
No generic plugin or DI framework.
No stubs for domain, runtime, evaluation, training, or cloud systems.
No dependency not directly required by the activated validators.
completion_criteria: The existing stored gh session is verified as abbudjoe without revealing or mutating credentials.
The four trusted checks are operational after W00 merge.
The final W00 PR follows the non-self-referential handoff protocol.
ChatGPT reviews the exact final head and Joseph explicitly authorizes that exact head in the current conversation.
A separate merge-only Sol turn posts the authorization record, waits for the required check, squash-merges, and produces post-merge evidence.
The governance report explicitly states that shared GitHub identity/credential is a procedural rather than cryptographic human/agent boundary.
No non-goal or future scaffold is present.
